node.title: E22 agreement cofactor equations
node.statement: For any listed E22 sunflower codeword f and its zero-agreement root set Z inside core union background, writing f=U L_Z converts every petal agreement on petal i into the cofactor equation U(x)L_{Z\C}(x)=a_i L_{C\Z}(x) after cancelling the common core factor. Thus the mixed/full-petal support-forcing problem may be studied entirely through these cofactor equations on petal agreement points.
node.attack_surface: direct locator factorization and cancellation in the local sunflower model
node.falsifier: a listed codeword and petal agreement point for which the stated cofactor equation fails after factoring zero agreements
